title: LibrarianImportFullPage
description: Output contract for the full-page import synthesizer. Produces the three section blocks of a project page in one response. Each block has the same shape as a single LibrarianSynthesis output. ('Where we are' is no longer a stored block as of PLAN_v3 delta #15 — served on demand by `brain-search intent=where_are_we`.)

new_block_body.description: Full markdown for this section block. Must include the heading line and the <!-- brain:block ... --> comment exactly as in the input's current_block_bodies for this section.
